rapport_notes: Patient and good-humored through a very long, complex, meandering call; respected the customer's privacy concerns and stayed graceful through the eventual price objection.

evidence_quotes.agenda: What are your biggest concerns for this upcoming move and what are the most important things you want answers to on this call today?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: I have several pieces that I will leave in storage... are you able to stack it separately? (answered fully once, no deeper follow-up on other possible concerns, including a later privacy concern)
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: this is just an estimate... you will only be billed for the actual hours rendered.

top_strength: Handled an unusually complex split move (storage plus apartment, room-by-room re-sorting) with patience and without losing composure, delivering a clear, honest estimate even though it exceeded the customer's budget.
coaching_note: Fully answered the storage-organization and privacy concerns but never asked 'what else is on your mind' to surface additional worries before moving into logistics.
